source.check: Nominations from the Lisburn Standard (5 May 1939, p. 4).

note: Triennial election, polled at the end of May 1939. There was no contest: nine members were nominated and seven retiring members were deemed re-elected where no nomination was received. Filed on 1939-06-01, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1939-05-31 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
